intro: Specialized software built for real operations. No vaporware, no hype, and zero AI slop—just reliable, purpose-built tools running daily on the frontline.

products.name: Hoststand
products.tagline: A reservation book that doesn't charge you per guest.
products.problem: Legacy reservation platforms penalize growing venues with $1 to $1.50 per-cover fees while holding guest data hostage. Meanwhile, hosts miss phone bookings during peak rush.
products.solution: Flat-rate monthly table management covering the reservation book, custom floor plan, live waitlist, and online booking. Includes an integrated voice AI receptionist that answers phone calls and books tables according to your host's exact rules.
features: Zero per-cover fees — keep 100% of guest revenue
Autonomous AI phone host books directly into live floor inventory
Smart pacing controls prevent sudden kitchen rushes
Two-way SMS waitlist with zero physical pagers to manage

products.name: SwiftOps Suite
products.tagline: By Restaurant IT, for the frontline. Resolve emergencies directly from your phone.
products.problem: When a POS terminal freezes or kitchen display bump bar locks up on a Friday night, IT managers shouldn't have to carry laptops through crowded dining rooms or wrestle with remote desktop logins.
products.solution: Instant pocket remediation for hospitality tech. Restart crashed POS services, bump stuck items from Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), reboot VM hosts, and power-cycle kiosk tablets in seconds using one-tap phone actions.
features: IT Ops Portal: Restart Windows POS services via secure SSH in 5 seconds
ScreenBumper: Clear stuck QSR kitchen display orders with one tap
Cloudflare SSO authentication with zero shared store passwords
Production-proven across 8 high-volume restaurant locations

products.name: DCR
products.tagline: Automate cash reconciliation. Reclaim 30–45 minutes per location every day.
products.problem: Store managers spend 45 minutes every closing shift transcribing POS z-reports into spreadsheets, manually auditing credit card batches, and hunting down drawer shortages.
products.solution: Nightly automated data pipeline directly connecting POS terminals and payment processors. Closing managers only enter physical cash counts, and any variance flags immediately in red before books are locked.
features: Automated POS & processor data sync before closing managers arrive
Instant discrepancy detection with visual variance alerts
Enforced posting deadlines and tamper-proof locked audit trails
Multi-location corporate oversight with central SSO access

products.name: Scardy Squirrel
products.tagline: Run event check reconciliation in 3 minutes instead of hours.
products.problem: Event managers lose hours matching paper POS checks to Tripleseat banquet bookings, taking blurry smartphone photos of receipts, and re-typing line items into client invoices.
products.solution: Dedicated financial reconciliation engine built for event teams. Pulls guest checks directly from POS, automatically matches event dates, generates audit-ready PDF receipts, and attaches them directly to Tripleseat records.
features: Automated POS check retrieval with line-item receipt matching
Native Tripleseat integration with auto-attaching PDF summaries
Multi-revenue center support across restaurants, lounges, and banquets
Client-ready final summaries and invoices generated in one click
products.image_alt: Scardy Squirrel event check reporting and receipt reconciliation

products.name: EasySignOut
products.tagline: Your team shares iPads. Now you'll always know who has which one.
products.problem: Paper sign-out clipboards get lost or ignored. Shared tablets go missing between shift handoffs, dead batteries sit undiscovered in lockers, and enterprise MDM is too cumbersome for shift staff.
products.solution: A streamlined digital sign-out kiosk replacing paper sheets. Shift employees enter a PIN or scan their badge in 5 seconds to claim a tablet. Managers see a real-time status board of every device across the floor.
features: 5-second frictionless kiosk workflow designed for shift workers
Live status board showing current holders and duration out
Automated return reminders before shift changes to prevent loss
Zero complex MDM profiles, certificates, or IT overhead required

products.name: EDISync
products.tagline: Know when your vendor's invoice doesn't match your contract — automatically.
products.problem: Food distributors and supply vendors frequently bill above contracted pricing rates. Accounting teams cannot realistically check thousands of individual line items across weekly delivery invoices.
products.solution: An automated invoice auditor that downloads EDI 810 invoices nightly via SFTP, verifies every single line item against your contractual price sheet, and emails immediate mismatch alerts before bills are paid.
features: Nightly automated retrieval of EDI 810 invoices over secure SFTP
Line-by-line contract comparison with configurable tolerance limits
Morning variance digest highlighting exact overcharge dollar amounts
Built specifically for independent operators, grocers, and restaurant groups

products.name: Squirrel Discount
products.tagline: Automate Squirrel POS discount and employee card usage processing.
products.problem: Retrieving employee meal discounts, VIP comps, and partner discount transactions from legacy Squirrel POS terminals requires manual SSH terminal sessions and tedious spreadsheet parsing.
products.solution: Dedicated automation bridge for Squirrel POS. Securely connects to terminals via Paramiko SSH, retrieves raw transaction logs, validates card numbers against central policy rosters, and generates clean accounting reports.
features: Automated SSH transaction retrieval directly from Squirrel POS terminals
Policy verification against centralized employee and VIP card rosters
Multi-venue support with consolidated accounting summaries
Complete transaction-level audit trail for finance and loss prevention
products.image_alt: Squirrel Discount POS usage dashboard and audit report

products.name: VoiceAgent
products.tagline: Intelligent Voice AI receptionist that answers every call with consistency.
products.problem: Front desk staff and hosts get overwhelmed during peak rush. Ringing phones go unanswered, placing potential customers on hold or sending high-value reservations and catering inquiries to voicemail.
products.solution: Autonomous voice AI receptionist answering customer calls with zero delay. Answers natural questions, checks availability, books reservations, performs warm transfers with spoken context, and texts instant confirmation links.
features: Immediate call pickup with zero hold times or caller drop-offs
Natural conversational dialogue with intelligent interruption handling
Warm call transfers with live context briefings to floor staff
Seamless PBX & CRM integration with Twilio, Telnyx, Yeastar, and HubSpot
